test_title: PYST 13: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 25 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.

(A) the concert was too expensive

(B) to watch his favourite

(C) hard-earned money

(D) to waste his parents'

(E) artist's live performance

(F) so he sacrificed the chance
solution:
The correct answer is: **ADCFBE**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct sequence of the sentence is: 
 
 
• **A **- "The concert was too expensive"
 
• **D **- "to waste his parents'"
 
• **C **- "hard-earned money"
 
• **F **- "so he sacrificed the chance"
 
• **B **- "to watch his favourite"
 
• **E **- "artist's live performance"
 
 
 
• When sequenced correctly, the sentence reads:
 
 
• "The concert was too expensive to waste his parents' hard-earned money on, so he sacrificed the chance to watch his favourite artist's live performance."
 
 
 
• This order logically and grammatically connects each part, providing a clear cause-and-effect relationship, and describing a situation where the cost of the concert influenced the person's decision to forgo attending the performance.
